print.documentIntro: This document contains the structured working version of your Founder Alignment session and is designed for workshops, in-person meetings, or offline work.

contextIntro.preFounder: A shared session for two founders who want to make key expectations, differences, and agreements concrete before working more closely together.
contextIntro.existingTeam: A shared session for an existing founder team to turn agreements from the report into concrete ways of working together.

vision_direction.title: Company logic
vision_direction.subtitle: How do you decide in everyday work what takes priority, what waits, and what pulls you away from your core focus?
prompts: What takes priority when revenue opportunity, product focus, and company building all pull at once?
Which opportunities or requests do you intentionally not pursue, even if they bring short-term money or visibility?
What applies when something brings revenue but pulls you away from the core focus?

roles_responsibility.title: Roles & responsibility
roles_responsibility.subtitle: How do you decide who leads, what stays visible, and when the other person needs to be brought in?
prompts: Which topics does one person lead clearly and independently?
Where does the other person need early visibility?
When does individual ownership become a shared topic?

decision_rules.title: Decision rules
decision_rules.subtitle: How do you make sure decisions stay clear under pressure?
prompts: What can one person decide alone without asking first?
When do both people need to agree?
What applies when you disagree and need to decide quickly?

commitment_load.title: Commitment & load
commitment_load.subtitle: How do you make effort, availability, and load visible early before quiet pressure builds up?
prompts: What is realistically manageable in normal mode?
What needs to become visible early when capacity starts tipping?
What do you reprioritize first when commitments are no longer sustainable?

collaboration_conflict.title: Collaboration & conflict
collaboration_conflict.subtitle: How do you handle feedback, clarification, and conflict so they do not linger or block daily work?
prompts: What do you address immediately, and what waits for a fixed clarification point?
How do you give critical feedback so it stays clear and does not land as an attack?
What happens when a topic is not resolved in the conversation?

ownership_risk.title: Ownership & risk
ownership_risk.subtitle: How do you define who leads risks, when they become visible, and at what threshold you decide together?
prompts: Which risks does one person lead alone, and where do you need early visibility?
Which threshold ends quiet observation?
When does safeguarding take priority over speed?

values_guardrails.title: Values & entrepreneurial guardrails
values_guardrails.subtitle: How do you define what is still sustainable, what remains a borderline case, and what is not your path?
prompts: Which compromises are still sustainable for you?
Which cases always need deliberate shared approval?
What do you not do, even if it looks economically attractive?

alignment_90_days.title: 90-day focus
alignment_90_days.subtitle: How do you clearly define for the next 90 days what takes priority, what waits, and how you measure progress?
prompts: What has absolute priority in the next 90 days?
What do you deliberately not do, even if it could seem useful?
How do you notice early that you are truly moving forward with your priorities?

advisor_closing.title: Advisor closing
advisor_closing.subtitle: Which observations, open questions, and next steps should the advisor make visible at the end?
prompts: What should this team not overlook after the session?
Which follow-up questions remain important?
What is the most useful next step?
